related_records.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.

related_records.reason: Bounded physical-fret terminology follow-up: behind a numbered metal fret is derrière la frette, not behind the whole case/space. Preserve the same wire position and sound-producing action; pressure hand is described functionally without adding handedness.

related_records.source: Pick an open string, then snap a fingertip down just behind fret 2. The new note sounds from the tap alone, with no second pick.

related_records.reason: Bounded physical-fret terminology follow-up: behind a numbered metal fret is derrière la frette, not behind the whole case/space. Preserve the same wire position and sound-producing action; pressure hand is described functionally without adding handedness.
